SELECT
    o.${s_topic_field} as uid,
    o.${s_mdl_dte_field} as sample_mdl_dte,
    o.uid,
    o.his_lmt_rise_ddf_mdl_dte_min,
    o.his_lmt_drp_ddf_mdl_dte_min,
    o.his_lmt_con_rise_ddf_mdl_dte_min,
    o.his_lmt_con_drp_ddf_mdl_dte_min,
    o.ds
FROM (
        SELECT
            s.${s_topic_field},
            s.${s_mdl_dte_field},
            f.uid,
            f.his_lmt_rise_ddf_mdl_dte_min,
            f.his_lmt_drp_ddf_mdl_dte_min,
            f.his_lmt_con_rise_ddf_mdl_dte_min,
            f.his_lmt_con_drp_ddf_mdl_dte_min,
            f.ds,
            row_number() over(partition by s.${s_topic_field} order by f.ds desc) as rn
        FROM ${sample_table} s
        LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT
                        *
                    FROM
                        dwa_risk_model.off_dp_dz_inner_behavior_adj_amt_enhanced_aggregation
                    WHERE
                        to_date(to_date(ds,'yyyyMMdd')) >= ${min_ds}
                    AND
                        ds <= ${max_ds}
                    ) f
        ON
            s.${s_topic_field} = f.uid
        AND
            datediff(to_date(s.${s_mdl_dte_field}),to_date(f.ds ,'yyyyMMdd')) = 0
    ) o  WHERE rn=1;
